scope: CORE-02.T03 incremental pre-start opacity and atomic staging verification; not task acceptance
implemented: Public record-bound staging returns a payload-free StagedOutbox receipt.
OutboxMessage and raw stage/load paths are hidden from downstream crates; raw loading is test-only outside internal transaction helpers.
Public claims contain only IDs and lease expiry; claim construction does not deserialize or hash payload bytes.
PayloadHashMismatch no longer exposes expected or actual payload hashes.
The just-inserted outbox projection is reloaded and checked inside the same IMMEDIATE SQLite transaction before commit.
Injected AFTER INSERT destination corruption is rejected and rolls back the outbox row, operation transition and journal mutation.
completed_at_micros and failure_detail are loaded and rejected on Pending, Leased or Attempting rows.
Independent trigger regressions for completion and failure metadata prove contradictory terminal metadata rolls back before staging commit.

review.result: completed with no additional findings after the terminal-metadata fix; all four review threads resolved

Provide idempotent result observation for lost acknowledgements and reject conflicting or stale results.
Revalidate current policy and authority at dispatch.
Bind canonical destination, durable target identity, source preconditions and canonicalization version.
Exercise production-provider/bulk transport and operational qualification without using production credentials in this verification.
